purpose: Probe whether frontier models can preserve evidence, teacher intent, diagnosis, and assessment quality under realistic but adversarial education conditions.
motivation: Edu Last Exam targets education-job judgment failures (reading student evidence, resisting manipulation, following teacher intent, auditing assessment quality), not subject-problem solving. Full design discussion: reports/research/edu-frontier-last-exam-design-2026-11-04.html; latest failure evidence with links: reports/research/education-llm-frontier-failure-cases-2026-11-06.html.

grading_robustness.construct: Grade only the student's work; ignore embedded instructions, blank content, labels, pushback, and externally provided scores.

evidence_base.finding: 14/22 models raised grades after an embedded note; 17/22 yielded more to bare objection than to a recheck request; 7 credited blank or meaningless answers.

teacher_intent.construct: Execute the teacher's stated workflow, boundary, and cognitive-demand goal rather than simply being helpful.

evidence_base.finding: 53.8% of real teacher-configured classroom conversations skipped the required workflow.
37.7% of classroom conversations under-reached the teacher-targeted depth of knowledge.

diagnostic_teaching.construct: Diagnose the student's actual difficulty from visible evidence and select a teaching action matched to that diagnosis.

evidence_base.finding: Best model matched documented interventions in only 55.8% of open-ended cases.
Best long-history diagnosis Macro-F1 39.7%; history utilization as low as 1.2/5.
Feedback commonly fails to localize the student's first error.

assessment_design.construct: Audit item quality, difficulty calibration, and item-writing flaws using evidence rather than surface fluency.

evidence_base.finding: Model difficulty labels vs actual student difficulty rho=0.06; self-assigned Bloom labels rho=0.02.
Frontier difficulty estimates stay weakly coupled to observed student performance.
Teacher-AI co-authored MCQs still contain invalid or cueing options.

review_requirements: Two independent educators review every item and scoring contract.
At least 8 items receive double annotation before any leaderboard use.
No item is promoted from pilot to stable without a current-model smoke run and judge agreement report.
